name: Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science)
description: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) bridges statistical mathematics, big data engineering, and modern computing architectures to extract valuable predictive insights from complex, high-velocity datasets. The curriculum encompasses Big Data Frameworks (Apache Hadoop, Spark), Data Mining, Predictive Analytics, Applied Probability & Statistics, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Wrangling, and Data Visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI). Students develop end-to-end data pipelines from ingestion to production model serving, supporting evidence-based decision-making across e-commerce, banking, logistics, and healthcare.
highlights: Approved intake of 60 seats affiliated with the University of Mumbai, focusing on end-to-end data engineering and statistical modeling.
Dedicated Data Engineering Lab, Machine Learning Lab, and Big Data Analytics Lab configured for distributed databases and high-volume data lakes.
Extensive exposure to Python data stacks (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Spark MLlib) and enterprise cloud analytics environments.
Hands-on participation in campus hackathons such as Nexathon, building predictive pipelines from massive datasets.
career_opportunities: Data Scientist, Big Data Engineer, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Consultant, Quantitative Analyst, Data Architect, and Machine Learning Engineer.
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based department of Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) that others would wish to emulate.
mission: Creating Exuberant Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) Professionals.
